label: D2 rare transition a1 -> S2
explanation: Reset gate unit that fires only at D2 (never D1/GO). Its strongest activations (top two quartiles nearly 100% covered, 87% of activation mass) occur when the agent chose a1 and was rarely transitioned to S2 (in_action==1 & in_state==2), dev P=0.84 R=0.68 F1=0.75. Missed activations are weak (13% of mass): a1->S1 common (~0.1-0.2 of max) and a2->S2 common (~0.3-0.5), i.e. weaker firing when either the a1 action or the S2 state input is present alone; never fires on a2->S1. False positives on a1->S2 tend to be late in the episode / after long rewarded streaks; activation rate declines strongly with ep_trial (adding ep_trial<85 raises precision to 0.93 at little F1 gain). Uses only observed inputs at D2.
